ns2:course.label: Professional Career Development
ns2:course.description: This course is for senior BFA Theatre majors and is designed to prepare students to enter the professional world. Resumes, online presence, social media, website, agents/managers, unions, entertainment taxes, and other topics will be explored. 1 undergraduate hour. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: For senior BFA Theatre Majors only.
